He then describes some absurd "Martian customs", everyone laughs out loud.

[Question]
Why does Xiao Li say this?

B. Xiao Li says this because he thinks talking about Mars can arouse his family's interest in science and educate everyone.
C. Xiao Li says this because he wants to show his imagination and creativity, making a deep impression on his family.
